slugify.acceptance: python3 -m py_compile text/slugify.py && python3 -c 'from text.slugify import slugify; assert slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"; assert slugify("!!!") == ""'

word-count.acceptance: python3 -m py_compile text/word_count.py && python3 -c 'from text.word_count import word_count; assert word_count("one two  three") == 3; assert word_count(" ") == 0'
